title: 第224章 问此间（五十二）
content_zh:
走到跟前伸手，又犯了难,原版的龙蛋，确实可以被巫罗背在筐里，至于这个加强加大的版本，别说背了，多看一眼感觉都要折寿啊。
晏欢当然不会为难他，他盘旋身体,变作小龙的形态,飞舞在刘扶光面前。
刘扶光捏着鼻梁，头疼道：“她直到跟巫罗成亲前夕，才从蛋里出来……”
“为什么不能是龙的形态？”晏欢耸耸肩膀,如果他是有肩膀的形态,那么他一定在做这个动作,“先天灵智一应俱全,破壳也好,龙形也罢,不过是心障的投射。她怕巫罗像血亲一样抛弃她，因此始终维持着龙蛋的状态,实际上，还是小孩子的心态。”
这一番剖析,确实是刘扶光想不到的,他没料到晏欢居然能说出这样一番话来。
所以,黎牧星在确定了巫罗的爱，确定了巫罗再也不会离开她之后，才从龙蛋中跃出，结束了封闭的状态。
“巫罗”与“黎牧星”结伴而行，走在梦境的大陆上。晏欢不光按照黎牧星的记忆捏人，他还捏造了许多刘扶光不曾见过的看客，将这个梦填充得便如现实。
“那些是谁？”刘扶光望着经过他们身边，高冠博带、仙风道骨的一群人，“我怎的从未见过。”
“老师？”巫罗与黎牧星行走大地时，也是谈天说地，想到什么说什么，因此，他不由多问了一句，“你还有老师？”
“我那时还很小，”最后，他说，“比现在这样大不了多少，但是出世便为真仙封正，身上又带着人皇氏和十一龙君的通天血债，完全不能控制自己的力量，只有真仙能靠近我，跟我说话、交流。”
晏欢笑道：“别误会，昔时的真仙，可不是现在这么孱弱纤细的，俱是古神陨落之后，首次得证大道的金仙。往上数个几十代，指不定是哪个神人混血的苗裔，说他们口出莲音、落字成玉，毫不夸张。后来的周易、金翠虚之流，跟他们比起来，就像半大的孩子一样稚嫩。否则，他们怎么有本事，能把我封正？”
他将一口气摄在唇齿间，又慢慢地吐出去，道：“他们封我成了至恶，也自知闯下大祸，为了补救，执意要将我教养成个恭俭温良、品德兼优的榜样。否则，他们怎么跟天道交待？”
刘扶光默默听着，六千年前，晏欢紧闭心门，恨他恨得比谁都紧，从不跟他说起这些往事，六千年后，纵是晏欢想说，他也懒得听，如今这样平和叙事的光景，确实罕见。
“可惜，他们想错了，”无目的黑龙嘶嘶冷笑，“人有人性，龙自然也有龙性。他们待我，还是想着性相近，习相远那一套，以为从小教起，就能令我耳濡目染，弃暗投明。”
“天生坏种，是吧，”刘扶光叹气道，“就像我天生是个好人……虽然这么说，有点自夸的意思。”
默然片刻，晏欢接着道：“我那时不懂他们在做什么，只知道他们天天说这个好、那个不好，实在聒噪厌烦得很。我观察他们数月，待他们习惯了我的注视之后突然下手，只差一点，我就能咬出那真仙的道体，令他染上污秽恶毒，成为第一名陨落的仙人了。”
他遗憾地嗟叹：“到底是经验不足……那些真仙吓得不行，为了惩罚我，他们把我关进一个没有光，没有风，没有生命……什么都没有的地方，叫我孤苦伶仃地过了好多年。多少年？记不清了，约莫也有个几百之数吧。从那一刻起，我便深刻地明白了一个道理，我引起的恶祸，倒还是诸世间第二可怕的事物。”
“那第一可怕的呢？”刘扶光觉得意外，他没想到，晏欢竟还会表达出谦虚的意味。
“是空虚。”他说，“什么都没有，连死亡亦消失了，一切都不存在，一切都没有意义，善与恶，爱和恨……不过流连琐事，不值一提。那里只有你自己，渐渐的，你连自己也会忘记。”
晏欢平静地说：“在那里，我学会了恐惧，仙人放出我后，我学会了伪装。我蛰伏了大概千年，待我弄清，他们用了什么法子将我拘禁之后……我有没有跟你说过，我是天底下任何老师都梦寐以求的学生？因为我总能抓住万事万物的本质，我是神。”

他笑了两声：“也许我的老师们现在还活着吧，不过，在那种地方，是死是活，又有什么要紧？”
刘扶光低下头，对于死去日久的真仙，他心中没有怨恨，但更不会宽恕，他想了想，忽然问：“那我呢？”
“钟山为虚无之源头，你将我扔下，抱的也是这样的念头吗？因为真仙安排了我和你的婚事，你对他们的恨也跟着转移到了我身上，所以才要用你觉得最可怕的刑罚，来报复我？”
content_en:
When I walked up to him and stretched out my hand, I encountered another difficulty. The original dragon egg could indeed be carried by Wu Luo in the basket. As for this strengthened and enlarged version, let alone carrying it, one more look would cost me my life.
Of course Yan Huan would not embarrass him. He circled his body, transformed into the form of a dragon, and flew in front of Liu Fuguang.
Liu Fuguang pinched the bridge of his nose and said with a headache: "She didn't come out of the egg until the eve of her wedding to Wu Luo..."
"Why can't it be in the form of a dragon?" Yan Huan shrugged. If he is in the form of shoulders, then he must be doing this action. "Innate intelligence is all available, whether it is broken shell or dragon shape, it is just a projection of the heart barrier. She is afraid that Wu Luo will abandon her like a blood relative, so she always maintains the state of a dragon egg. In fact, she still has the mentality of a child."
This analysis was indeed unexpected by Liu Fuguang. He did not expect Yan Huan to say such words.
Therefore, after Li Muxing was sure of Wu Luo's love and that Wu Luo would never leave her again, he jumped out of the dragon egg and ended the closed state.
"Wuluo" and "Li Muxing" walked together on the dreamland continent. Yan Huan not only fabricated the person based on Li Muxing's memory, he also fabricated many spectators that Liu Fuguang had never seen before, making the dream look like reality.
"Who are those?" Liu Fuguang looked at the group of people passing by them, with high-level diplomas and noble demeanor, and asked, "How come I have never seen them before."
"Teacher?" Wu Luo and Li Muxing were chatting as they walked across the land, talking about whatever came to mind. Therefore, he couldn't help but ask, "Do you still have a teacher?"
"I was still very young at that time," he said in the end, "not much older than I am now, but I was anointed as a True Immortal when I was born, and I carried the blood debt of the Human Emperor and the Eleven Dragon Lords with me. I couldn't control my own power at all. Only the True Immortal could get close to me, talk to me, and communicate with me."
Yan Huan said with a smile: "Don't get me wrong, the true immortals of the past were not as weak and slender as they are now. They were all golden immortals who had attained the Great Dao for the first time after the fall of the ancient gods. Going back dozens of generations, it is impossible to tell which god-human hybrid seedling Yi, it is no exaggeration to say that they speak lotus sounds and write jade words. Compared with them, Zhou Yi and Jin Cuixu are as immature as half-grown children. Otherwise, how can they have the ability to seal me? "
He took a breath between his lips and teeth, and slowly exhaled it, saying: "They made me the most evil person, and they knew that they had caused great trouble. In order to make up for it, they insisted on raising me to be a model of thrift, gentleness, and good moral character. Otherwise, how could they deal with the law of heaven?"
Liu Fuguang listened silently. Six thousand years ago, Yan Huan closed her heart tightly and hated him more than anyone else. She never told him about these past events. Six thousand years later, even if Yan Huan wanted to say it, he was too lazy to listen. Nowadays, such peaceful narratives are indeed rare.
"It's a pity that they thought wrong," the aimless black dragon hissed and sneered, "Humans have human nature, and dragons naturally have dragon nature. When they treat me, they still think that they are similar in nature and far away in practice, thinking that they can make me abandon the darkness and turn to the light since I was young."
"I'm born a bad person, right," Liu Fuguang sighed, "It's like I was born a good person... although saying that is a bit boastful."
After a moment of silence, Yan Huan continued: "I didn't know what they were doing at that time. I only knew that they were saying this was good and that was not good every day. I was really tired of the noise. I observed them for several months. After they got used to my gaze, I suddenly made a move. I was just a little bit away from biting out the Tao body of the true immortal, making him contaminated with filth and viciousness, and became the first immortal to fall."
He lamented regretfully: "It was due to lack of experience... Those true immortals were so scared that in order to punish me, they locked me in a place with no light, no wind, no life... nothing, and made me live alone for many years. How many years? I can't remember, maybe.There may be a few hundred. From that moment on, I deeply understood the truth that the evil disaster I caused was the second most terrifying thing in the world. "
"What about the scariest thing? "Liu Fuguang was surprised. He didn't expect that Yan Huan would express humility.
“It’s emptiness. He said, "There is nothing, even death has disappeared, everything does not exist, everything is meaningless, good and evil, love and hate...it's just trivial matters, not worth mentioning." There is only yourself there, and gradually, you will forget even yourself. "
Yan Huan said calmly: "There, I learned to fear, and after the immortal released me, I learned to disguise. I have been dormant for about a thousand years. After I figured out what methods they used to detain me...Have I ever told you that I am the student that any teacher in the world dreams of? Because I can always grasp the essence of all things, I am God. "
He laughed twice: "Maybe my teachers are still alive now, but in a place like that, what does it matter whether they are dead or alive? "
Liu Fuguang lowered his head. He had no resentment in his heart for the long-dead True Immortal, but he would not forgive him. He thought about it and suddenly asked: "What about me? "
"Zhongshan is the source of nothingness. Do you think so when you throw me down? Because the real immortals arranged my marriage to you, your hatred for them has also been transferred to me, so you want to use the punishment you think is the most terrifying to retaliate against me? "
